messages:
Rhea (People Ops): Quick thread to lock down one-off exceptions for the cycle + how to present LOA/new-hire notes to calibration. Need short examples we can paste into the form help text.
Alex (Eng Manager): TLDR: make the form require a category and a compact rationale; examples would help managers write consistent notes.
Marta (Product Manager): Also include guidance for when managers should give a provisional rating vs leaving 'insufficient data'. I had ambiguous cases last cycle.
Devon (HRBP): Operational rule proposals: 1) >30% LOA -> mark 'Partial data (LOA)'; 2) <90d tenure -> 'New hire <90d' default; 3) Contractor->FTE -> record conversion date. Provisional ratings allowed but must be flagged.
Rhea (People Ops): OK adding those. For help text examples, how about three 1-line templates managers can pick/modify: a) LOA: "Employee on parental leave 6/15-8/20; observed impact limited to pre/post-leave projects; provisional rating flagged for calibration." b) New hire: "Joined 7/1; ramping on core infra; insufficient data for full cycle rating; recommends ramp goals." c) Conversion: "Converted from contractor on 9/10; prior work was project-based; recommend discussing pre/post conversion context in calibration."
Alex (Eng Manager): Those are great; maybe add a short note about evidence links: "Attach 1-3 artifacts (PRs, dashboards, decks) that support your note."
Marta (Product Manager): One more: if a manager misses the deadline due to emergency LOA, what's the extension path?
Devon (HRBP): Managers may request a 7-day extension via Helpdesk. For escalations (manager on LOA), HRBP can authorize an exception and flag the direct reports so calibration can schedule a follow-up slot. We'll surface those in the packet.
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: review forms due in 24 hours. Forms & exceptions: https://docs.internal/redwood/reviews/forms | https://helpdesk.internal/redwood/review-exceptions :bell:
Rhea (People Ops): I'll publish the help snippet + templates and enable a dropdown + required rationale field. Will also auto-check "Flag for calibration" for Partial data and Conversion categories by default. Posting update in 20m; DM me if you want a quick 5-min walkthrough. :thumbsup:
